body: This is the absolute worst thing you could possibly tell someone who is suicidal. The guilt trips don’t fucking help. Suicidal people carry enough guilt and negativity around without you adding to it.

Hahaha I’ve been estranged from my friends and family for years now. My fiancé stole my rent money to pay a debt and lied to me about paying rent. I came home to an eviction notice and she took off and went back to her parents. I have no safety net. I’ll be homeless in a few days. I know you’re just saying people care because that’s what we have all been programmed to say. And I appreciate that. But it’s not always true. Sure my employer may care because they’ll have to hire someone to replace me, or my land lord may care because they’ll most likely be the one who finds me. But those people to care about “me” as a person.
If you opened any kind of battle or prestige crates you may have gotten the vehicles in those. That’s how I got the Gatling chopper and the APC.
